subject.title: Support Workers AI model selection during onboard

question: Should the official Cloudflare plugin add a first-class Workers AI or multi-provider mode, or remain an Anthropic passthrough with Workers AI documented through the generic custom-provider flow?
rationale: The two paths define different permanent provider identities, model catalogs, endpoint behavior, and compatibility expectations; source inspection cannot determine which product contract maintainers want.

options.title: Add an additive provider mode
options.body: Keep existing Anthropic behavior and add a supported Workers AI or REST bridge mode with provider-owned onboarding, catalog metadata, documentation, and upgrade tests.

options.title: Standardize the custom-provider path
options.body: Keep the Cloudflare plugin Anthropic-only and document a complete non-interactive Workers AI custom-provider workflow instead of adding plugin surface.

recommendation.title: Add an additive provider mode
recommendation.body: Keep existing Anthropic behavior and add a supported Workers AI or REST bridge mode with provider-owned onboarding, catalog metadata, documentation, and upgrade tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They landed the original provider and are the strongest available history signal for deciding whether its official product scope should expand.
